name: Neuwied (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and red, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Neuwied (a peacock on a chequy field beneath a tower and a cross).
history: Municipal flag of Neuwied; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Neuwied arms — peacock, tower and cross
